Bengaluru Father Kills Two Daughters in Hotel, Attempts Suicide

A father identified as Imran killed his two minor daughters by strangulation in a five-star hotel near Bengaluru airport. He then attempted suicide and was found in critical condition. Police are investigating the motive, with initial reports suggesting a dispute over child custody and marital issues. A handwritten note was reportedly found at the scene, which helped uncover the case.
